segments.name: Patient services
segments.description: Fee-for-service and value-based oncology care delivered through affiliated clinics, covering physician visits, infusion, radiation and patient support.
segments.evidence: TOI provides medical care on a fee-for service basis for physician services, in-house infusion, radiation, and innovative programs like outpatient blood product transfusions, along with 24/7 patient support.

segments.name: Specialty pharmacy
segments.description: Specialty and retail pharmacies filling oral, IV and injectable medications for oncology patients, billed to pharmacy benefit managers.
segments.evidence: TOI operates specialty and retail pharmacies in all 5 states through which we are capable of filling medication orders that are incidental or coincidental to our patients' oncology care.

segments.name: Clinical trials & other
segments.description: Clinical trial services for pharmaceutical companies and contract research organizations, plus palliative care for patients.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business and reports its results through three operating and reportable segments: specialty pharmacy, patient services, and clinical trials & other in accordance with ASC 280.

revenueModel.text: Managed care payors pay a fixed monthly amount per enrolled member, and insurers and pharmacy benefit managers pay for visits and prescriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: Capitation revenue is paid monthly to the Company based on the number of enrollees assigned to the Company by the contracted managed care organization (per member, per month; or "PMPM").
